integrity: The graph, all matching faces, an independent matching-polynomial recurrence, every mod-2 simplicial boundary rank, the chain condition, and the Euler-characteristic check are reconstructed by the bundled standard-library verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for mod-2 homology of the ordinary matching complex of the 16-vertex Clebsch graph. No integral-torsion, homotopy-type, or infinite-family claim is made; an ordinary residual risk of an unindexed equivalent finite computation remains.
title: Mod-\(2\) homology of the Clebsch matching complex
